name: data.gov.au (CKAN API)
summary: Metadata API for data.gov.au, the Australian government open data catalogue, over a keyless CKAN Action API.
description: Search dataset metadata, organisations and resource links for Australian federal, state and local government data. A package_search for 'climate' returned 11,731 datasets at check. Datasets mostly link out to files on agency sites; some resources are queryable through datastore_search.

endpoints.summary: Search dataset metadata (q, fq, rows, start, sort)
Full metadata and resource list for one dataset

example.response_excerpt: {"help": "https://data.gov.au/data/api/3/action/help_show?name=package_search", "success": true, "result": {"count": 11731, "results": [{"id": "e12e911c-01f4-5f1b-8001-8fb312d202c5", "name": "fedora-pid_csiro-64751", "title": "Agricultural climate metrics for the National Climate Risk Assessment", "license_id": "notspecified", "num_resources": 312, "...": "..."}]}}

license.name: Per dataset (portal text is CC BY 4.0)

agent_notes: Use the generic CKAN docs for parameters; the portal does not publish its own API page that I could find. Read license_id per dataset.
caveats: No data.gov.au-specific API documentation page was found; the docs link is the upstream CKAN API guide, and the CKAN version of this site was not confirmed.

verification.notes: Exact example request executed without a key; package_show, organization_list and package_list also returned 200.
